lead.headline: Golden still hasn't practised, and Loveland's claim locks at 01:00
lead.deck: 1-6. Claim Loveland for Stroud tonight, Daniels into the QB slot; Pickens covers Golden on Thursday.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Matthew Golden sat out Tuesday's walkthrough after Monday's DNP — shoulder and a new foot injury LaFleur has not explained — and Green Bay play Thursday. If he is ruled out Wednesday or inactive Thursday, George Pickens takes his slot. Metcalf Gala also fixed their lineup this afternoon and now project 121, against 91 for Bloodsports as set. The claim that closes most of that is Colston Loveland: Cole Kmet's season is over and Chicago are leaning on him. It costs priority that never resets, and this is the case priority is for. Claims process at 01:00 tonight — the Wednesday brief is too late. Put Jayden Daniels, whose projection rose today, into the QB slot for Stroud. One morning worry is gone: Josh Jacobs's day-to-day tag has cleared.
